title: andromeda cernua
intro: Andromeda cernua, commonly known as bog rosemary, is a flowering plant native to eastern North America. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as an antimicrobial agent, due to its ability to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and fungi. The bioactive constituents of Andromeda cernua include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues.
